paite: Rehoboam bel Shekem ah ahoh a; Israelte tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
heading: Mallam Namte Helna / (1 Kum 12.1-20)

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu azak in, Aigupta gam a kipan Jeroboam ahong pai nawn hi; amah kumpipa Solomon kiang a kipan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi ngal a.
Mi asawl ua, ava sam ua; huchi in Jeroboam leh Israel tengteng ahong pai ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
"Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah a; huaiziak in na pa'n hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua akoih hon sukzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum khit chiang in hong pai nawn zaw un," achi a, huchi in mipite akihemkhia uhi.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in, "Hiai mipite dawnna ding thupha bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" chi in apa Solomon dam lai a upate kiang ah adong hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai mipite na hehpih a na kipahsak a, akiang ua thuhoih tata na genleh tangtawn in na mite ahi ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
Himahleh, upate hoihsakpih apom kei a, amah khanvualpih tangvalte, akiang a om sekte adong zosop hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai mipite ka kiang a, 'Na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol akoih hon hihzangsak in chi a gen mite ka dawndan ding hoih bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" " achi hi.

Akhanvualpih tangvalte'n akiang ah hiai mipite na pa'n ahakkol uh ahihgik thei mahmah a, nang zaw hon hihzangsakzaw in na kiang a hong gen mite kiang ah huchi in chi inla, huchi in akiang uah gen in, "Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutzung agolzaw.
Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na posak a, ke'n ahihleh na hakkol uh behlap lai ding ka hi, ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon sawi zel a, ke'n ahihleh aikam a hon sawi ding ka hi," chi in agen uhi.
Huchi in Jeroboam leh mipite tengteng kumpipa'n, "Ani thum khit chiang in hong nawn un, achih bang in ni thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Kumpipa'n amaute gumtak in adawng a, kumpipa Rehoboam in upate thuhilhna apom kei.
Tangvalte phatsakpih bang in, ka pa'n na hakkol uh ahihgik a, ke'n huai behlap ding ka hi; ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon na sawi a, ke'n zaw aikam a nou hon sawi ding ka hi," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Shilon mi Ahijah zang a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a athu gensa akipsak theihna ding in kumpipa'n mite thugen Pathian ziak in apom kei hi.

Kumpipa'n athu uh apom kei chih Israelte tengteng in atheih un mipite'n: "David ah tantuan bang ahia i neih uh? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei sam kei uh, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un: David, na inkuan sung ngaihtuah mai in, chi in kumpipa adawng uhi." Huchi in Israel tengteng apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
Israel suan Judah gam khua a omte bel atung uah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasem dia asawlte uh heutu Hadoram asawl a; amah huai Israelte tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Jerusalem a tai tum in akangtalai ah kumpipa Rehoboam atuang pah hi.
Huchi in tutan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ahelta uhi.
